## What you ran

Which command(s) did you try? (e.g., `koji-lens summary`, `koji-lens compare --since 30d`, `lens summary`)

## What you wanted but didn't find

Features, views, or details you expected but couldn't reach.

## Optional: how you use Claude Code

Personal / team? Pro/Max subscription / API key? Solo dev / small team / larger org?
(Helps us understand who's reaching the tool — share only what you're comfortable with.)
